page.layout: One column of text, full width at top; a woodcut illustration of a globe with a ship and a tower in the middle; running text continues below the illustration. Digitiser's URL at the foot is excluded. Margin letters a, b, c beside the woodcut are part of the illustration and are described under notes.

main_text.l: In tumorem assurgit, qui ex carina
prospicientem impedit, in eminenti loco consistentem non impe-
dit, quod mali summitas aut superat aut æquat
per decliuia ferri, et ex altioribus ad humiliora loca delabi ac
exæquet ea, & aliquo concludatur, & coherceatur obstaculo,
ne decidat aut diffluat, nec cauitatem
in medio aliquam efficit. Colligitur ergo intra uacuos terræ
meatus eó usq;, donec superficiem æquet conuexam,
At terram cum circumfluis sibiq; infusis aquis,
a, b, c: letters of reference on the woodcut, not printed text.

page.notes: The woodcut shows a globe with land, a ship, a castle and a tower, with reference letters a, b, c. Last line "scente," is set at the right margin. Line "debi scente" appears to be a line-end break of "debiscente" (gaping); kept as printed. Some letters in the text are faint.
